call_points.text: No numeric FY27 guidance; management declined to predict export growth due to geopolitical uncertainty.
CV >6T industry production grew 8.4% in Q1FY27; ZF's CV >6T sales grew 8.6%.
ESC manufacturing starts Q3 next year; localisation near 40-50% now, above 75% by SOP.
OEM commodity and FX cost recovery typically lags two quarters; this time it has taken longer than usual.
July 2026 heavy vehicle production averaged 40,000-42,000 units, about 10,000 higher than a typical July.
Board approved Rakesh Mishra as CFO effective September 1, 2026, succeeding Sweta Agarwal.
US and Europe markets declined about 10% YoY, though the US is now ramping up.
Full-suite ADAS business awards already won from two OEM customers; discussions ongoing with other OEMs.
ESC/ADAS regulation for vehicles above 6 tonnes takes effect October 2027; first mandated deliveries begin then.
Aluminium rose from about ₹233 to ₹274 per kg; customer recovery conversations are ongoing with a lag.
FY26 segment growth: OE 17.5%, aftermarket 15.5%, exports -11%, service income +10%.
Q4 segment growth: OE 25%, aftermarket 21%, exports -6%; Americas -22%, Europe +6%.
OEM content per vehicle fell to about ₹39.5K in Q4 from ₹45.5K in Q3, which had one-off price variances.
Diesel price increases could hit freight rates and fleet buying capacity, with a lag.
US exports still about 20-22% below year-ago levels, though the gap is narrowing and US production has trended up.
April and May 2026 volumes are better than prior years, and management expects a good quarter.

operating_notes.text: OEM content per vehicle was about ₹45.5K in Q3FY26 and ₹39.5K in Q4FY26, the Q3 figure lifted by one-off selling price variances.
Aluminium rose from about ₹233 per kg to ₹274 per kg, roughly 18% higher, and is a major raw material.
Mahindra World City plant utilisation is at almost peak level; further expansions will be at Oragadam.
Aftermarket sales were ₹158.4 Cr in Q1FY27, up 15.6% YoY, with a highest-ever monthly aftermarket sale of ₹63.06 Cr in June 2026.
ESC localisation is near 40-50% now and guided above 75% by SOP, with manufacturing to start in Q3 next year.
Aluminium rose from about ₹260/kg to over ₹360/kg, easing about ₹25 in July 2026.
